title: Adobe Connect is affected by an Improper Neutralization of CRLF Sequences ('CRLF Injection') vulnerability that could…
description: Adobe Connect has a critical vulnerability classified as Improper Neutralization of CRLF Sequences (CRLF Injection). This flaw could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code within the context of the current user without requiring any user interaction. The vulnerability has a scope change, indicating that it may affect components beyond the initially vulnerable code. The CVSS score is 10.0, reflecting its critical severity and potential for complete confidentiality and integrity compromise without availability impact.
